summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026 disclosing that Wrightbus has nominated Ballard as the fuel cell supplier for its next-generation hydrogen bus platform. No financial terms, stake percentages, or transaction structure were provided. This is a routine commercial agreement announcement, not a special situation. There is no M&A, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. No further risk-arb or event-driven angle exists.
